$comment: Edit content/i18n/<lang>/texts.json then run tools/regenerate-tts.mjs to re-record only changed lines. Change a voice/model/instructions below to re-record a whole language. Add a category (text, captions, answers, glossary, easy-read) or textId to `exclude` to mute it; remove it to re-record it. Set API keys via the env vars named here.

en-GB.instructions: Speak in a cheerful and positive tone.

gemini.note: Gemini TTS uses GEMINI_API_KEY; word highlighting still uses OPENAI_API_KEY (Whisper).

azure.note: Azure regeneration is not yet supported by this standalone script — regenerate Azure languages from ADT Studio.
